verdict.rationale: SigNoz supports managing dashboards as code and editing or downloading their full JSON spec, which lets teams version and review them in external source control. Service accounts give CI/CD pipelines API access, and Agent Skills let AI assistants create and modify dashboards and alerts. Nothing shows built-in version history, change review, or rollback for alerts, log pipelines, or other automations, so versioning depends on outside tooling. Missing for 10: native versioning/history of alerts and pipelines, a review/approval workflow, one-click rollback, and documentation of an automations-as-code workflow beyond dashboards.
